Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Michael Whitbread <mw...@earthsciences.uq.edu.au> wrote:
>Can a succubus club trade be made on a contested card? I don't think so since
>the card is temporarily out of the game. Anyone like to rule on this?

The contested card is not considered to be in play, so cannot be traded
via the Club, correct.

>Furthermore, if someone has a haven uncovered on my vampire, then I can't
>trade that using the Club since it isn't under my control really right?

You can't trade the Haven Uncovered, right.
